category_edits.rationale: Test fixed-norm 0.75 tied item embeddings across all four datasets to reduce GRU input magnitudes and candidate magnitudes. Preserve width 128, exact zero padding, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so inference uses identical normalization without checkpoint shape changes.

change_summary: Change tied item embeddings from unit norm to fixed norm 0.75, preserving zero padding and predictor consistency. Require the host-provided data directory.
